ops.text: Whole-suite single-process pytest runs can hit KeyError: 'pydantic.root_model' — an earlier non-NLP test pollutes sys.modules, then the lazy 'import spacy' (state.py:37 via signals/nlp.py:162) fails building EditTreeSchema, cascading into ~18 NLP test failures. Pre-existing, not consolidation-caused: every file passes in isolation; pre-importing spacy inoculates. Candidate fix: session-autouse conftest fixture importing spacy first.
